payload.title: Guard decide-relevance --apply without an explicit doctrine
payload.description: papyrus references decide-relevance --apply defaults --doctrine to corpora/papyrus-publication-doctrine.yml (Threat Intelligence's doctrine), so a sweep for another site silently seeds that site's new cyclotron store with TI's mission (happened to p.apyr.us). Require an explicit --doctrine with --apply; dry run prints the doctrine it would use; guard every other command that seeds from the default.
